component-o.description-s: Single-cell Li-ion/Li-Po protection IC, OV 4.280V/UV 3.000V/OC 0.080V, external dual N-FET, SOT-23-6

cfgpins-ao.4c: Test pin for delay time measurement; leave open in application

cfgpins-ao.5c: R1 470 ohm (300 ohm-1 k) from VDD to the cell positive EB+ (net eb_p), ESD and power fluctuation (ABLIC Figure 10, Table 17); VDD carries the strap, not the battery role
C1 0.1 uF (>= 0.022 uF, else DO may oscillate on a short) between VDD and VSS (cell negative)

cfgpins-ao.6c: VSS = cell negative B- (ds-battneg net): joins FET1 (discharge) source only, never the pack/system ground

cfgpins-ao.2c: R2 2 kohm (300 ohm-4 k) from VM to EB- (net eb_n = pack negative = board ground avss), reverse-charger protection

cfgpins-ao.1c: DO drives the discharge FET gate (DMN2019UTS-13 G1) over ds-prot-dfet

cfgpins-ao.3c: CO drives the charge FET gate (DMN2019UTS-13 G2) over ds-prot-cfet

external_fets-o.topology-s: dual N-channel in the cell's return: FET1 discharge (gate DO, source VSS = cell -), FET2 charge (gate CO, source EB- = pack -), drains common
external_fets-o.requirement-s: FET Vth <= overdischarge detection voltage (3.000 V); gate-source rating >= charger voltage (ABLIC Table 17 *1 *2)
external_fets-o.source-s: ABLIC S-8261 Rev.5.5 p24 Figure 10 / Table 17
external_fets-o.nets-s: eb_p = cell/pack positive EB+; VSS (pin 6) = cell negative; avss = pack negative EB- (system ground)
